svg.title: Hardware LFSR: 32-stage shift register with two 32-channel feedback multiplexers and XNOR feedback
svg.desc: A 32-stage D flip-flop shift register with a common clock. Each register output branches to one input channel of two 32-channel multiplexers A and B. Each multiplexer selects one channel via a 1-of-32 decoder with five channel-control inputs. The two selected outputs, tap A and tap B, feed an XNOR gate whose output returns to the data input of stage 1.
